title: selliguea finlaysoniana
intro: Selliguea finlaysoniana, commonly known as the Khas or Khas-khas, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae, which comprises various species of ferns. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Southeast Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea finlaysoniana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and to confirm its safety for use in medicinal applications.
